content.user_title: Analyze Search Terms for Better Paid Campaigns
content.value_statement: Paid-search exports can hide converting queries and costly irrelevant traffic. This skill turns an export into keyword opportunities, negative keywords, n-gram waste findings, and a reviewable maintenance diff.
actual_capabilities: Extract converting search queries as candidate keywords or ad-group themes.
Identify search terms with spend and no conversions for negative-keyword review.
Summarize recurring waste patterns with an n-gram analysis.
Create an add, negate, or move maintenance diff from the export.
Use query, impression, click, cost, conversion, and conversion-value fields when available.
Save a reusable mining summary only after user confirmation.
limitations: It relies on the accuracy and completeness of the supplied search-terms export.
It recommends actions but does not apply changes in an advertising platform.
It does not design account structure, allocate budgets, or calculate a final account-quality score.
Sparse conversion data can make negative-keyword recommendations less reliable.

use_cases.title: Review monthly search-term waste
use_cases.description: Find costly non-converting queries and produce a negative-keyword review list.

use_cases.title: Discover new keyword themes
use_cases.description: Turn proven converting queries into candidate keywords and ad-group themes.

use_cases.title: Prepare a client optimization report
use_cases.description: Create a clear maintenance diff and n-gram waste summary from a client export.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: review an export
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a recent search-terms CSV.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this search-terms export. List candidate keywords, negative keywords for review, and the evidence for each recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: find waste patterns
prompt_templates.scenario: You want to reduce irrelevant paid-search spend.
prompt_templates.prompt: Mine this export for queries with spend but no conversions. Create an n-gram waste report and group the proposed negatives by theme.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: build a maintenance diff
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a structured change proposal.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this search-terms export to create a maintenance diff with Add, Negate, and Move sections. Include query metrics and state any assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: compare periods
prompt_templates.scenario: You have current and prior search-term exports.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these two search-terms exports. Identify new converting themes, emerging waste, and changes to the negative-keyword review list.

output_examples.input: A search-terms export with cost, conversions, and conversion value.
output: Candidate keyword: "emergency plumbing repair" because it has conversions and strong value.
Negative review: "free plumbing course" because it has spend and no conversions.
Waste theme: "course" appears across several non-converting queries.

output_examples.input: A monthly export from a prospecting campaign.
output: Negate: irrelevant queries after human review.
Move: queries that need a more specific ad group.

best_practices: Export sufficient date range and include cost, conversion, and conversion-value columns when possible.
Review negative-keyword recommendations for relevance before applying them.
Use consistent campaign and match-type context when interpreting query performance.
anti_patterns: Do not add every non-converting query as a negative keyword without checking volume and intent.
Do not treat a small export as conclusive evidence of long-term performance.
Do not use this skill as a substitute for budget allocation or account-structure planning.

faq.question: What file should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a native ad-platform search-terms export with query and performance metrics.

faq.question: Can it change my campaigns?
faq.answer: No. It creates recommendations for your review and does not apply platform changes.

faq.question: What metrics are most useful?
faq.answer: Queries, impressions, clicks, cost, conversions, and conversion value provide the strongest analysis.

faq.question: What is an n-gram waste report?
faq.answer: It groups repeated words or phrases found in costly non-converting queries.

faq.question: Should I accept every negative-keyword recommendation?
faq.answer: No. Review intent, match type, volume, and business relevance before adding negatives.

faq.question: Does it build campaign structure?
faq.answer: No. It identifies query-level maintenance actions, not a complete account structure.
